none: PAS FindID 986043: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, probably Arles mint. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: two soldiers with one standard between them, a crescent on the vexillum. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXERC ITVS. In exergue: probably CONS. Diameter: 14.5mm, Weight: 0.92gms, die axis: 6
